title: Plastic constitutive emitter
objective: Emit Taichi predictor-corrector radial return update with power-law hardening Newton solve.
implementation_steps: Emit elastic predictor: trial stress from elastic tangent
Emit yield function evaluation: f = sigma_eq_trial - sigma_y(alpha)
Emit plastic corrector: radial return with Newton iteration on delta_lambda
Emit power-law hardening: sigma_y = sigma_y0 + K*alpha^n
Emit convergence check for local Newton (plastic multiplier)
Add von Mises near-zero guard (sigma_eq < 1e-12*sigma_y per 07-CONVENTIONS)
Verify single-point update reproduces reference stress-path
acceptance_criteria: Single-point update reproduces reference stress-path from P1.2
Elastic predictor matches SVK for below-yield loading
Von Mises near-zero guard prevents division by zero
risks: Local Newton convergence for large plastic increments — may need line search
Plastic multiplier must satisfy delta_lambda >= -1e-15 per 07-CONVENTIONS.md
